Design and produce mechanical and plumbing systems design calculations, equipment selection, drawings, and scope of works. Review pump sizing and selection, operating requirements and technical data to ensure compatibility with the relevant civil and electrical systems. Review the design of mechanical and plumbing services of projects. Review and approve Submittals of Technical Material and Shop Drawings submitted by the Contractors for mechanical and plumbing services of projects. Assist in testing, commissioning, training, performance verification, training and handover of mechanical and plumbing deliverables to clients/beneficiaries Project Assessment and Quality Assurance Support the project team in reviewing design briefs and design reports that address specific clients and stakeholder requirements and specifications as and when necessary. Support the project team in reviewing design documentation (e.g., drawings, BOQ, and specifications) to meet the required quality and detailing as stipulated by the Project Manager. Work closely with different project team members during the planning phase, particularly in reviewing the assessment report and design brief summarizing the scope of work fulfilling the needs of the beneficiary, scheduling tasks, and developing an integrated design. Review the design documents assuring that they meet the quality standard requirements. Timely deliver the expected outputs. Contribute to the design review services meeting the Client’s Design requirement and support the project team in QA/QC relevant activities to assure that the relevant sections in the design comply with international standards and codes of practices. Join the project team during site inspections and assessments as required and review the assessment reports only when required Software and Administrative Support Has the capacity and experience in using drafting software such as Autodesk – AutoCAD and Revit. Has the capacity and experience to use standard mechanical & plumbing engineering systems design software. Assist in mechanical and plumbing engineering related material archiving. Assist in scheduling requested tasks related to mechanical works. Perform any other tasks relevant to the Infrastructure and Engineering Unit when required WASH and Pump supervision Review and assess mechanical and hydraulic design for water systems, including pumping stations, boreholes, and transmission lines, ensure compliance with project requirements and international standard. Supervise the installation, testing, and commissioning of mechanical equipment for water supply and irrigation systems, including pumps, valves, piping systems and related mechanical components. Supervise the approved Bills of Quantities (BOQs), technical specifications, and material submittals for mechanical components related to water and sanitation infrastructure, ensuring accuracy and completeness. Other related tasks at the request of the UNOPS lesion senior officer Administrative and Documentation Tasks Contribute to the archiving and management of design and engineering documentation for mechanical systems. Contribute to maintaining organized records, ensuring timely scheduling and tracking of project tasks. Prepare inputs for periodic progress reports, highlighting work achievements, challenges, and recommendations. Education Requirements Required Bachelors degree in Mechanical Engineering with 2 years of relevant experience Desired License/Board Certification in Mechanical Engineering Required Experience Requirements At least 2 years of experience in Mechanical, firefighting, and Plumbing systems design, supervision and construction for medium to large scale construction projects is required. At least two years of working experience in project assessment, design and supervision experience in rehabilitation projects/ construction projects is required. Excellent skills in drafting using Autocad are required. High proficiency in working on HAP software is required. High proficiency in dealing with computers, and other software/ platforms related to the position's field of expertise. Desired Work Experience with an international Organization and/or UN Agencies is an asset. Good experience in working with the G-Suite platform including, Google Drive, Google Calendar, Gmail, Google Sheets, Docs, and Slides is an asset. Experience with pumps, pumping stations, boreholes, potable water supply, irrigation systems or similar infrastructure is highly desirable. Previous experience working within the Syrian context and targeted areas will be an added advantage.

review_candidates.title: IT Manager
review_candidates.description: [MUSINSA] MUSINSA was born in South Korea as an online fashion community and has grown into one of Asia's leading fashion commerce platforms. With a membership base exceeding 20 million and over 10,000 brand partners, we are currently accelerating our rapid global expansion. Driven by our growth in the Japanese market, we are building a powerful local team to sustain our fast-growing e-commerce operations, our partner brand ecosystem, and our community-led fashion culture. [Position Overview] We are establishing the very first IT position at MUSINSA JAPAN. In this role, you will design the end-to-end architecture of our core systems—including POS, ERP, WMS, 3PL, and EC—that power both our online and offline business. You will lead external vendors and SIers to build a seamless infrastructure where inventory, order, and product data flow uninterrupted. Additionally, you will oversee and supervise IT infrastructure service desk operations (managing PCs, smartphones, peripherals, and software applications) by collaborating with general affairs, external vendors, and the headquarters IT team to ensure flawless day-to-day operations. As this position sits at the center of MUSINSA JAPAN's future store expansion, EC channel growth, and O2O strategies, it plays a vital role directly linked to our business success. [Core Responsibilities] 1. Designing data integration and synchronization workflows across POS, ERP, WMS, 3PL, and EC platforms (Shopify, Global Store, ZOZOTOWN). 2. Selecting, managing, and driving projects with external vendors and SIers. 3. Collaborating with the headquarters IT team to localize core systems for the Japanese market. 4. Supervising IT infrastructure operations (management of PCs, smartphones, peripherals, and software accounts) in coordination with General Affairs, external MSPs, and the headquarters IT team to ensure appropriate operations. 5. Formulating the IT roadmap aligned with store expansions, brand growth, and O2O strategies. [Key Duties & Responsibilities] 1. Online & Offline Integrated System Architecture Design Designing data flows and synchronization logic across POS, ERP, WMS, 3PL, and EC systems. Integrating POS replacement, ERP introduction, and 3PL migration under a unified set of architectural principles. 2. Vendor & SI Selection and Project Management Handling requirements definition, RFP creation, vendor comparison, contracting, and progress tracking. 3. Cross-Channel Integration Design Determining real-time synchronization mechanisms for Shopify-ERP, ZOZOTOWN-ZOZOBASE, and online-to-offline store inventory. 4. Lightweight Development & PoC Creating simple scripts or data conversion tools, and conducting reviews of externally developed code. 5. Supervision of IT Infrastructure & Security Operations Setting up PCs and software applications for onboarding and offboarding employees. Troubleshooting IT hardware and equipment issues as needed. Supervising General Affairs and external MSPs to ensure seamless operations. Managing peripheral equipment (printers, POS terminals, etc.) as well as SaaS and application accounts. Overseeing network and security operations. 6. IT Product Roadmap Formulation Setting investment priorities tailored to O2O strategies accompanying store and brand expansions. [Required Qualifications] 1. Practical understanding and hands-on experience in building or integrating at least two of the following: ERP, POS, WMS, or OMS. 2. Ability to comprehend API specifications and data models to determine optimal integration methods. 3. Proven experience in vendor management, RFP creation, contracting, and project tracking (ability to write basic scripts is a strong plus). 4. Experience in service desk or IT support operations. 5. Business-level proficiency in English or Korean. [Preferred Qualifications] 1. Experience leading online-to-offline (O2O) integration projects within the fashion or retail sector. 2. Experience with system design or data migration in a global South Korea-Japan environment. 3. Hands-on experience in Shopify operations and customization. 4. Understanding of cloud computing and asynchronous processing (e.g., AWS, Kafka). 5. Backend development experience (e.g., Java, Kotlin). [Ideal Candidate Profile] 1. Strong logical thinking and analytical skills. 2. Ability to act swiftly and adapt to fast-paced, dynamic environments. 3. High level of flexibility and resilience. 4. Deep understanding of MUSINSA's brand and culture, with the ability to reflect it in recruitment and team development. 5. Autonomous self-starter who also thrives in team collaborations. 6. Strong adaptability to environments where structures and workflows need to be built from scratch. 【MUSINSA】 MUSINSAは、韓国でオンラインファッションコミュニティとして誕生したアジアを代表するファッションコマースプラットフォームの一つです。 2,000万人以上の会員数と1万以上のブランドパートナーを抱え、現在グローバル展開を急速に加速させています。 日本市場の拡大に伴い、急成長するEコマース事業、パートナーブランドのエコシステム、そしてコミュニティ主導のファッション文化を支える強力なローカルチームを構築しています。 【ポジションの概要】 MUSINSA JAPANで初めてITポジションを設立いたします。本ポジションは、オンライン・オフライン事業を支える基幹システム（POS、ERP、WMS、3PL、EC）の全体設計を担い、外部ベンダーやSIerをリードしながら、在庫・注文・商品データが途切れなく流れる仕組みを構築する役割です。 加えて、総務や外部ベンダー、本社のITチームと連携しながら ITインフラ周りのサービスデスク業務（PC・スマホ・周辺機器・アプリ管理など）を監督し、運用が抜け漏れなく行われるよう管理する役割も含まれます。 本ポジションは、今後のMUSINSA JAPANの店舗やECチャネル拡大、O2O戦略の中心となるため、事業成長に直結する非常に重要なポジションです。 【主な役割の定義】 ①POS・ERP・WMS・3PL・EC（Shopify、Global Store、ZOZOTOWN）間のデータ連携・同期の仕組み設計 ②外部ベンダーやSIerの選定・管理・プロジェクト推進 ③本社ITチームと連携し、日本向けにシステムのローカライズ ④総務・外部MSP・本社ITチームと連携し、PC・スマホ・周辺機器・アプリ管理などITインフラ運用が適切に行われているかの監督 ⑤店舗拡大・ブランド拡大・O2O戦略に合わせた ITロードマップ策定 【主な職務内容】 ①オンライン・オフライン統合システムアーキテクチャ設計 ・POS、ERP、WMS、3PL、ECのデータがどう流れ、どこで同期されるかの設計 ・POSの入替、ERPの導入、3PL切替を一つのアーキテクチャ原則での統合 ②ベンダー・SIの選定・プロジェクトの管理 ・要件定義、RFP作成、ベンダー比較、契約、進捗管理 ③チャネル間の連携設計 ・Shopify–ERP、ZOZOTOWN–ZOZOBASE、オンライン–店舗在庫のリアルタイム同期方式の決定 ④軽量開発・PoC ・簡単なスクリプトやデータ変換ツールの作成、外部開発のレビュー ⑤ITインフラ・セキュリティ運用の監督 ・入退社者のPCやアプリケーションのセットアップ ・必要に応じてIT機器に関するトラブルシューティング ・総務や外部 MSPが適切に運用しているかを監督 ・周辺機器（プリンター、POS端末など）の管理及び、SaaS・アプリのアカウント管理 ・ネットワーク・セキュリティ運用の監督 ⑦ITプロダクトロードマップ策定 ・店舗やブランド拡大に伴うO2O戦略に合わせて投資優先順位の設定 【必須要件】 ①ERP・POS・WMS・OMSのうち2つ以上の実務理解と構築／連携経験 ②API仕様・データモデルを理解し、連携方式を判断できる能力 ③ベンダー管理・RFP作成・契約・進捗管理の経験（簡単なスクリプト開発ができれば尚可） ④サービスデスクの経験 ⑤ビジネスレベルの英語もしくは韓国語力 【歓迎要件】 ①ファッション／リテール領域でのオンライン・オフライン統合プロジェクト経験 ②韓国–日本のグローバル環境でのシステム設計・データ移行経験 ③Shopify 運用・カスタマイズ経験 ④AWS・Kafkaなどクラウド／非同期処理の理解 ⑤Java/Kotlinなどバックエンド開発経験 【求める人物像】 ①高い論理的思考力をお持ちの方 ②変化の大きい環境でスピード感を持って動ける方 ③柔軟性に富んでいる方 ④MUSINSAのブランド・カルチャーを理解し、採用・育成に反映できる方 ⑤自律的に動きながらも、チームと協働できる方 ⑥ゼロベースで仕組みを作れる環境への適応力

review_candidates.title: Director of Recruiting
review_candidates.description: SUMMARY The St. Louis Chapter of the National Electrical Contractors Association ( STL NECA or Chapter ) is a nonprofit, employer trade association representing over 100 electrical and telecommunications contractors throughout Eastern Missouri. STL NECA works to advance the electrical construction industry through labor relations, advocacy, education, research, and workforce development. GENERAL JOB DESCRIPTION STL NECA has developed a new opportunity for a Director of Recruiting ( Director ) to help Chapter member contractors identify, attract, hire, and retain the experienced talent necessary to grow their businesses and successfully execute their work. The Director will focus on recruiting experienced electrical construction professionals, including field personnel at the journeyman level and above, as well as project managers, estimators, superintendents, safety professionals, BIM/VDC personnel, and other management, technical, and professional positions needed by member contractors. The Director reports directly to the Chapter’s Executive Vice President and will work closely with STL NECA member contractors to understand their workforce needs, develop candidate pipelines, and connect qualified individuals with career opportunities throughout the Chapter’s jurisdiction. QUALITIES FOR SUCCESS The Director will recruit for field, management, and professional positions within the electrical construction industry. The ability to understand contractor workforce needs, evaluate a candidate’s experience and qualifications, and credibly communicate with both candidates and employers will be essential to success. Successful candidates will ideally have prior recruiting experience within the electrical or construction industry, or meaningful experience working within the construction industry itself. Experience recruiting skilled trades, project managers, estimators, superintendents, or other technical professionals is particularly valuable. Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to use data and recruiting technology to manage candidate pipelines and measure results will also be important. SPECIFIC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES The Director is responsible for, and has commensurate authority to accomplish, the responsibilities set forth below. These duties are not listed in any particular order or category and are subject to review, addition, or deletion as may be required to achieve success. Recruiting & Candidate Development  Develops and maintains a pipeline of experienced electrical construction professionals. Proactively identifies and recruits qualified candidates through direct outreach, referrals, industry networks, social media, job boards, and professional organizations. Interviews and evaluates prospective candidates based on experience, qualifications, project history, and career objectives. Connects qualified candidates with employment opportunities at STL NECA member contractors. Member Contractor Support Works directly with member contractors to identify current and anticipated workforce needs. Assists contractors in recruiting difficult-to-fill field, management, technical, and professional positions. Develops an understanding of each contractor’s operations, culture, hiring needs, and growth objectives. Assists member contractors in strengthening their recruiting, interviewing, and hiring practices. Industry Outreach Develops relationships with industry organizations, recruiting firms, colleges and universities, military transition programs, and other sources of experienced talent. Represents STL NECA at industry events, career fairs, networking programs, and other recruiting opportunities. Identifies opportunities to attract experienced electrical construction professionals to Eastern Missouri. Monitors workforce trends, major projects, compensation practices, and hiring needs within the electrical construction industry. Recruiting Metrics & Reporting: Tracks candidates, contractor needs, interviews, placements, and recruiting activity. Develops measurable recruiting goals and evaluates the effectiveness of recruiting strategies and sourcing channels. Provides regular recruiting and workforce activity reports to the Executive Vice President and Board of Directors. Assists with other duties and projects as needed.  COMPENSATION & BENEFITS Competitive salary commensurate with experience Performance-based bonus Nonelective Defined Contribution Pension Plan, with employer contributions made regardless of employee contributions  Vehicle allowance Family Health & Welfare Coverage Group Basic Life and Accidental Death and Dismemberment Insurance Generous leave policy, including vacation, personal days, and sick leave Candidates interested in applying for this position should send their resume and cover letter to STL NECA’s Executive Vice President, Kyle McKenna ( kyle@stlneca.org ) by Wednesday, October 7, 2026. STL NECA is an equal opportunity employer. We offer a great work environment, a competitive salary commensurate with experience, and industry leading benefits.

We solve the last-mile infrastructure problem by vertically integrating across the entire value chain of American power - from greenfield development, to algorithmic optimization, dispatch, and power trading across a fleet of distributed resources - allowing us to deliver power where and when it's needed most on the grid.
